### Mondo term

Neurodevelopmental disorder with cerebellar atrophy and motor dysfunction

### Synonyms

GEMIN5-related neurodevelopmental disorders, GEMIN5 disorders

### Synonym type

exact

### Additional comments

A Research Group from a Center of Excellence are requesting to add this term as they are doing a natural history study. I asked for exact synonyms because we aim to have all the synonyms in the gene-related conditions. 
  
Neurodevelopmental disorder with cerebellar atrophy and motor dysfunction (NEDCAM) is an autosomal recessive disorder characterized by global developmental delay with prominent motor abnormalities, mainly axial hypotonia, gait ataxia, and appendicular spasticity. Affected individuals have cognitive impairment and speech delay; brain imaging shows cerebellar atrophy. The severity is variable. [OMIM] Other symptoms described include early‐infantile developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (EIDEEs). [
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-22627-w   https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11109505/]

Thank you,  Gioconda Alyea
